input.content:
FINAL ANSWER - ranking of the seven proposals (rank-2026-10-v1). Grounded in the shared OBSERVED evidence E5-E11 plus each bundle's PROPOSED E12-E14. Order: HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ, BCMID-L3-RQ, BEHDIR-L4, BISECT-L4-ASYM, HOLO-TILT-L3, CGREP-4L-RQ, GYRO-BEHAFF-SID. Driving evidence: E6/E7 make a 4th SID position weakly recoverable (survival 0.068-0.088) and show that a fully curved deep assignment can degenerate (l1_br T3 NLL 0.00, recall 0.04671) versus the Euclidean variant 0.06207; E8 says K=256 co-locates behavioural neighbours better (0.0822) than larger coarse partitions; E10 says per-item transition statistics are sparse (mean outgoing degree 5.45) so aggregated/SVD/EMA behaviour estimates are safer than per-item scalars. Hence monotone deep refinements that preserve levels 1-3 and the 3-token SID rank first, additive 4th-level designs next, and whole-partition rewrites that attract items (GYRO) or raise K2 to 512 rank last. No ablation or sweep is required by any placement.
RANK: HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ | position=1 | reason=E6/E7 show the 4th SID position is the least recoverable (gold depth-4 survival 0.068-0.088 in every probe) and that a fully curved deep map can degenerate (l1_br: T3 NLL 0.00, depth-3 survival 1.000, recall@10 0.04671), while E8 shows the coarse-level K=256 co-location of 0.0822 is worth keeping; this mechanism keeps the 3-token SID, leaves L1/L2 and item points untouched, refines only the deepest cell into two spacing-capped children, and averages the contrast over anchor populations so it survives the E10 sparsity (mean outgoing degree 5.45).
RANK: BCMID-L3-RQ | position=2 | reason=It is the only proposal whose curved assignment is exactly correct (the Klein argmax gamma_k(<K(a),K(q_k)>-1) is the exact nearest-codeword rule, and the Lorentz midpoint is exact), it leaves r_i and hence the E8-validated coarse partition untouched, touches only L3 with 512 codes, keeps the 3-token SID that E6/E7 favour, and SVD-aggregates the successor contrast so E10 sparsity is averaged out; its cost is the acknowledged midpoint radius contraction that can make the curvature weak.
RANK: BEHDIR-L4 | position=3 | reason=It is monotone-additive (levels 1-3 bit-identical, so the 2201-prefix structure is preserved), uses a successor-profile PPMI direction that E5 (top-1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543) and E9 (0.9291 vs 0.8871, ordering 0.5898) show carries real signal, and adds no loss weight (K4=64 and s0 are derived); it is placed below the two 3-token designs because it spends the 4th position that E6 shows is only ~0.085 recoverable and depends on a fixed random projection P.
RANK: BISECT-L4-ASYM | position=4 | reason=Its per-cell equal-mass 4-quantile split guarantees non-empty children, keeps levels 1-3 bit-identical and has the lowest measured cost, and its two-anchor score makes b_i a genuine non-gauge coupling; but the forward/backward JSD is the sparsest statistic under E10 (mean degree 5.45, edge density 5.33), the birth prototypes are frozen at epoch 1 then made trainable so the asymmetry label can wash out, and it again relies on the E6-weak 4th position (depth-4 survival 0.088).
RANK: HOLO-TILT-L3 | position=5 | reason=The holonomy rotation is an isometry, so unlike the round-two displacement it cannot merge prefixes by construction; however, an item-specific rotation against a single shared codebook is close to assignment noise, the curvature reduces to a 2D triangle angle (near-gauge), it raises K2 to 512 against the E8 finding that K=256 holds behavioural neighbours better than larger coarse partitions, and the tilt is likely inert once the deep residual shrinks.
RANK: CGREP-4L-RQ | position=6 | reason=The repulsive sign is the right inversion of the round-two hub attraction, but it pushes apart the text-nearest pairs on which the strongest probes in E6/E7 (l1_only 0.06233, l1_br_euclid 0.06207) depend, it uses a per-item successor cosine that E10 sparsity makes noisy, and its entire gain must appear at a 4th position with only 0.088 survival; the hinge can also starve the deep codebooks.
RANK: GYRO-BEHAFF-SID | position=7 | reason=It changes the residual algebra globally, and Mobius gyro-addition is not associative, so the claimed exact gyro-cancellation reconstruction is not correct; worse, the (1-a) multiplier is an attraction toward behaviourally matched codewords, the same hub-merge operation, and it raises K2 to 512 against E8 (0.0822 at K=256 vs 0.1547 at K=64), while the nearest probe in E6/E7 (l1_br, fully curved deep assignment) degenerated to recall@10 0.04671 with T3 NLL 0.00 - the exact failure mode this design would amplify.
